name: unsafe fn ptr_rotate_gcd < T > (left : usize , mid : * mut T , right : usize)
rule: The range of `left + right` elements of type `T` starting at `mid - left` and ending just before `mid + right` must be valid for reading and writing.
api: unsafe fn ptr_rotate_gcd < T > (left : usize , mid : * mut T , right : usize)
